release_notes:
Release 1.0.30 — billing address capture, order-form redesign, and order reliability fixes

Checkout & billing
- Buy Credits: billing address split into Address Line 1 (required) and Address Line 2 (optional); all billing fields are now required and validated before payment can proceed; fields are prefilled from the customer profile.
- PayPal: credit purchases are recorded as a physical-goods order — invoice id, product description, and the billing address used as Ship-to (including Address Line 2).
- Stripe: the billing address is recorded as the shipping address on the transaction (physical-goods framing). Also fixes a missing Stripe SDK bootstrap that made Stripe checkout fatally error.
- My Profile: customers can now view and update their address (Address Line 1/2, City, State, Zip), which prefills checkout.

Reports
- New CRON Log page (Reports -> CRON Log): per-run cron execution log with job, status, duration and details, plus a purge action.

Admin / API services
- API Services: added a Service Status column (Connected / Disconnected) and a filter to show only Disconnected services.
- Package API history: history rows can be deleted, and the currently-active API/service is marked Active vs Previous, validated against the live connection.

Order forms
- Redesigned IMEI order entry to match the current theme: single IMEI input capped at 14 digits with the 15th check digit computed automatically; single / bulk / both driven by the service configuration; an Add-to-list helper for bulk entry; and a coherent field kit for custom fields (text box, text area, dropdown, radio) and standard fields.
- Redesigned the My Profile page into clear, theme-consistent sections.

Order reliability (important)
- Fail-safe order placement: the order record is now written and verified BEFORE credits are charged, for IMEI, File and Server orders. Previously, if the order insert failed (e.g. an oversized custom-field value under strict SQL mode), the customer's balance could be debited with no order created and nothing visible to admin. Now the customer sees a clear error and is not charged.
- Text Area custom-field values (such as long GSX / case-history reports) are no longer truncated or rejected — those columns are stored as TEXT.
- Order-details and credit-history views preserve line breaks in custom-field values; credit history gains a "+" order-details popup consistent with the orders list.
